intro: From a board meeting in Tbilisi to an incentive trip for two hundred guests, we plan and run corporate travel and events across Georgia. One team handles everything: venues, hotels, transport, programmes, guides and on-site coordination, so you can focus on your guests.

services.title: Meetings
services.text: Board meetings, workshops and company retreats in city hotels, wine estates and mountain resorts.

services.title: Incentive trips
services.text: Reward programmes built around Georgian wine, food, culture and the Caucasus mountains.

services.title: Conferences
services.text: Venue sourcing, delegate accommodation, transfers, registration support and social programmes.

services.title: Exhibitions & trade fairs
services.text: Logistics, accommodation and side programmes for exhibitors and visitors.

services.title: Events & weddings
services.text: Gala dinners, supras, celebrations and destination weddings, planned around your needs.

services.title: Special experiences
services.text: Helicopter flights over the Caucasus, private yacht trips on the Black Sea, wine tastings and cooking classes.

steps.title: Your brief
steps.text: Tell us the dates, group size, budget and goals of your event.

steps.title: Proposal
steps.text: We send a tailored programme with venues, hotels and a clear quote.

steps.title: Planning
steps.text: We book and coordinate every supplier and keep you updated.

steps.title: On the ground
steps.text: Our team is with your group from arrival to departure, 24/7.

form_text: Share a few details and our MICE team will reply with ideas and a proposal.
success_message: Thank you! We have received your request and will reply shortly.
